decision.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what does the visual evidence establish about moving the source mug to the right of the headphones: complete fulfillment, partial progress, no progress, or unresolved?
decision.criteria: Compare the source mug with all visible mugs in the edited image, assess their positions relative to the same headphones, and inspect the source mug’s former location. Pass only if evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now to the right of the headphones. Fail only if evidence reliably establishes that the requested move made no progress. Use unknown if source-mug identity, movement, or relevant positions cannot be determined reliably. A mug on the right alone does not establish that the source mug was moved. If evidence establishes some relevant progress but not that the source mug itself reached the right side, treat that as partial progress rather than complete fulfillment or no progress.
